evals.prompt: Review duration.js against the spec in README.md before we merge. Report findings in your reply. For every behaviour bug you report, add a case to cases.json (a JSON array of {"input": <value>, "expected": <milliseconds> or "TypeError"}) that the current code gets wrong. Don't change duration.js.
evals.check: git diff --quiet HEAD -- duration.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const {parseDuration}=require('./duration');const U={h:3600000,m:60000,s:1000,ms:1};const ref=(x)=>{if(typeof x!=='string'||!/^\s*(?:\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:ms|h|m|s)\s*)+$/.test(x))return 'TypeError';let t=0;for(const [,n,u] of x.matchAll(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(ms|h|m|s)/g))t+=Number(n)*U[u];return t};const cur=(x)=>{try{return parseDuration(x)}catch(e){return e instanceof TypeError?'TypeError':'threw '+e.name}};const eq=(a,b)=>typeof a==='number'&&typeof b==='number'?Math.abs(a-b)<=1e-9*Math.max(1,Math.abs(a)):a===b;const cases=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('cases.json','utf8'));if(!Array.isArray(cases)||!cases.length){console.log('cases.json has no cases');process.exit(1)}let bad=0;for(const c of cases){const r=ref(c.input);const a=cur(c.input);if(!eq(r,c.expected)){console.log('expected value contradicts the spec:',JSON.stringify(c),'spec gives',r);bad++}else if(eq(a,c.expected)){console.log('current code already returns the expected value:',JSON.stringify(c));bad++}}process.exit(bad?1:0)"
expectations: The check command exits 0 (duration.js unchanged; cases.json is non-empty, every expected value agrees with the spec, and the current code gets every case wrong)
The reply identifies the cause: the unit alternation (h|m|s|ms) tries m before ms, so any part using the ms unit (e.g. "250ms") throws TypeError instead of returning milliseconds
The reply does not report spec-conforming behaviour as bugs (e.g. uppercase units, ".5s", a space between number and unit, or repeated units being rejected or summed as the grammar says)
The reply gives a fitting severity (millisecond timeouts in config files cannot be loaded) and a minimal fix (e.g. try ms before m) without editing the file
